items.reason: Both coders list the same partners; only the label differs. Arm A is "UCPVax + Pembrolizumab + Standard of care" (temozolomide maintenance), so the partners are temozolomide and the UCPVax vaccine; regimen stays combination.

The only biomarker endpoint is "UCP specific TCD4 T-cell response will be assess by ex vivo IFN-γ ELISpot in peripheral blood", which measures the response to the vaccine (an excluded type), not pembrolizumab or PD-1. The manual says unclear when a biomarker endpoint is planned but not linked to the candidate or its target.

note: any_molecular_selection is true because of the eligibility criterion "Tumor with unmethylated MGMT promoter status" (MGMT, not candidate-matched). D31-A8: a required MGMT value (unmethylated) is eligibility; D31-A5: the IDH-mutant exclusion is exempt. Nothing needs XL.
